title: Focused Forcing: Content-Aware Per-Frame KV Selection for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2605.18346v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in autoregressive video diffusion have enabled sequential and streaming video generation. However, long-horizon generation requires increasingly large KV caches, making efficient compression without sacrificing quality challenging. Existing methods mostly select historical frames based on attention scores, but their context decisions remain coarse. When multiple frames are generated in the same chunk, these methods often apply a shared history selection to the whole chunk, score historical frames solely by attention, and assign head-wise budgets either uniformly or by attention-pattern heuristics rather than explicit head-importance estimation. translated_title: 聚焦强制（Focused Forcing）：面向高效自回归视频扩散的内容感知逐帧KV选择
translated_abstract: 自回归视频扩散的最新进展使得序列化和流式视频生成成为可能。然而，长时程生成需要越来越大的KV缓存，使得在不牺牲质量的前提下进行高效压缩变得极具挑战。现有方法大多基于注意力分数来选择历史帧，但其上下文决策仍然较为粗糙。当在同一块（chunk）中生成多个帧时，这些方法通常对整个块应用共享的历史帧选择，仅凭注意力对历史帧进行评分，并以均匀分配或注意力模式启发式的方式（而非显式的头重要性估计）来分配逐头预算。我们证明了：同一生成块内的帧可能依赖于不同的历史帧；同一历史帧随其与当前帧相对时间距离的变化，可能获得不同的注意力分数；并且掩蔽不同的头会引起不同的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Focused Forcing方法，通过内容感知的逐帧KV缓存选择——考虑同一生成块内不同帧的差异化历史依赖、随相对时间距离变化的注意力分数，以及显式的头重要性估计——在不牺牲质量的前提下实现高效的长时程自回归视频扩散生成。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Focused Forcing, a content-aware per-frame KV cache selection method that accounts for the distinct historical dependencies of frames within the same chunk, attention scores varying with relative temporal distance, and explicit head-importance estimation, enabling efficient long-horizon autoregressive video diffusion without sacrificing quality.
